prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. THREE rows. TOP OLA adult female saw worker, broad shoulders, dark tied hair, russet tunic and long brown leather apron, safely lowered small hand saw with bluntly simplified teeth. MIDDLE LIN adult male local forest keeper, mature clean-shaven face, moss hood down over brown tunic, plain walking staff; no military insignia. BOTTOM OUSHA adult female birch-woods patrol worker, grey-streaked tied hair, faded charcoal green knee-length tunic over brown trousers, plain small closed field notebook tied at belt. No national uniform, household addresses, punishment or patrol completed.
